[SWS_Dem_CONSTR_06168] Required DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFI-
CATION for events
⌈
If an DemEvent refers an DemDTC that itself requires snap-
shot record or extended data records that contain a
DemInternalDataElement
=
DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFICATION
, the
DemEventAssociatedIden-
tification
shall be configured for that event.

[SWS_Dem_00470]
⌈
If the Dem module implements customer-specific Dem-internal
data elements, the configuration parameter
DemInternalDataElement
shall be ex-
tended with the respective enumeration values.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04190)
Note: The computation of any Dem-internal data value, which is not configured as data
element, can be discarded (if it is not necessary for other internal behavior handling).
[SWS_Dem_01045]
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DemInternalDataElement
is
set to
DEM_CURRENT_FDC
, then the fault detection counter shall be mapped to the
respective data element.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04190)
For details see chapter 7.7.3.
